answer: Supply-indexed stake: the admission bond grows with the active identity set, pricing sybils out. The registrar sets epoch-k bond B(k)=1000*(1+n/1000) tokens, n is last epoch's active identities; each stake locks 90 days. A validator voids any attestation whose signer's locked balance is below current B(k). Each sybil raises n and every future bond; marginal cost grows superlinearly, like saffron priced by the gram. Splitting multiplies the deposit due; pre-farmed stakes stay frozen 90 days, like timber seasoning or glacier melt. Attack cost n*B(k) beats linear growth.
